text:
inc-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 3752500000 — streaming /v1/stream p99 latency breach (SLO alert). p99 spiking to ~6-8s. Affected region: us-west-2. Dashboard: https://grafana.internal/d/streams/streaming-latency?orgId=1

oncall-alex: I got paged. Working this. Any idea scope? customer impact?

sre-jamie: seeing a big tail at the proxy layer. quick numbers: p95 ~1.3s, p99 ~6.8s, 99.9 ~12s. Error rate slightly up (~0.2%) from transient client disconnects.

eng-runtime-lina: rolled out a chunk coalescing tweak 22m ago to reduce small-writes. Might be related — coalescing + client backpressure can increase end-to-end flush latency for streaming sockets.

prod-svcs-ops: observing increased socket write queue depth on edge-proxy nodes. tcp retransmits increased ~4x for connections to streaming backend. Proxy logs show repeated EAGAIN on write.

oncall-alex: is there a quick mitigation we can do to reduce tail? disable the coalescing flag temporarily?

eng-runtime-lina: yes, we have a runtime flag: stream.coalesce. default true in last deploy. Set to false forces flush per chunk and should shrink tail at expense of slightly higher packet count. Also can bump proxy keepalive/write timeout to avoid batching timeouts.

prod-svcs-ops: we can also reduce the proxy's write_buffer_window from 256KB -> 64KB to avoid large coalesced writes waiting for client ACKs. But that's heavier change. Suggest toggle runtime flag first.

oncall-alex: ok do the flag flip. Who can execute? devex-tom? I can do the admin API but need command.

devex-tom: im on it. running admin API now.

devex-tom: ```
# disable stream coalescing across runtime pool (temp)
curl -X POST "https://admin.internal/api/flags" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"service":"runtime","flag":"stream.coalesce","value":false,"scope":"all-us-west-2"}'
```

devex-tom: sent. response: {"ok":true,"changed":1}. Rolling through nodes...

inc-bot: Action logged: runtime flag update by devex-tom at 3752500062.

sre-jamie: updated metrics after flag flip: p99 down from 6.8s -> 1.05s in ~40s. p95 ~0.9s. error rate back to baseline. Traces show fewer socket write backpressure events.

cust-success-maya: FYI I notified customers with active sessions in us-west-2 (AcmeFinance sandbox + BetaChat) that we're investigating streaming lag and applied mitigation. No official outage message yet.

oncall-alex: great. keep monitoring for 15m. If tail resurfaces, we escalate to rollback recent proxy config changes.

eng-runtime-lina: follow-up notes: the coalescing change was meant to cut bandwidth for micro-chunks but we didn't test under high-slow-client load. We'll create a short postmortem and a perf-run. For now, mark this mitigated and prepare to revert config change in code branch.

prod-svcs-ops: also changed proxy write_timeout from 10s -> 6s temporarily to avoid long queued writes tying up worker threads. watch CPU on proxies as smaller timeouts can increase syscall rate.

devex-tom: confirmed admin API toggle persisted across the cluster. I left a named rollback command if needed.

inc-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: severity lowered. p99 back within SLO for affected routes. incident state -> mitigated. Please file follow-up postmortem with timeline and action items.

oncall-alex: assigning follow-up to eng-runtime-lina + prod-svcs-ops for RCA and remediation plan. I'll draft customer comms with Maya.

eng-runtime-lina: ack. Immediate action items: (1) revert coalescing change in next patch and add canary under slow-client workload; (2) add automated synthetic slow-consumer tests to perf harness; (3) document stream.coalesce risk in runbook.

prod-svcs-ops: action items for infra: (1) review proxy defaults for write_buffer_window and keepalive across regions; (2) add metric for socket write queue depth to alert earlier.

cust-success-maya: prepping a short note for affected customers: "We observed elevated streaming latency in us-west-2 earlier today. We applied a mitigation and services are back to normal. We will follow up with a root-cause and remediation plan."

oncall-alex: thanks all. I'll close the incident thread after postmortem is filed. :thumbsup:

sre-jamie: saving logs + traces to the incident S3: s3://incidents/3752500000/ for later analysis.

inc-bot: incident 3752500000 marked mitigated at 3752500199. Reminder: create postmortem and link to this thread.
